experimentSuggestions.title: Matched-species islet vitrification vs slow-freezing benchmark
experimentSuggestions.hypothesis: The current islet corpus overweights slow-freezing, so a matched-species comparison is needed to separate real vitrification gains from endpoint and species confounding.
experimentSuggestions.rationale: The cleaned islet slice contains many slow-freezing studies, a smaller vitrification set, and a few comparative papers. A direct benchmark with the same species and the same post-thaw function readout is the fastest way to convert that literature asymmetry into actionable signal.

experimentSuggestions.title: Additive-assisted islet recovery benchmark on a fixed base cryomix
experimentSuggestions.hypothesis: Several islet papers imply that recovery gains may come from adjuncts added around a standard cryomix rather than from entirely new base CPA chemistry.
experimentSuggestions.rationale: Trehalose, curcumin, beraprost, and other adjunct-style titles recur in the curated islet slice, but they are not benchmarked against one another on the same base protocol. Holding the core cryomix fixed and comparing post-thaw recovery/function would quickly test whether the additive signal is real.

experimentSuggestions.title: Promote islet function-heavy protocols to transplantation endpoints
experimentSuggestions.hypothesis: Several islet protocols that look promising on insulin secretion or in-vitro function will reorder once they are compared on graft or transplantation outcomes.
experimentSuggestions.rationale: The curated islet slice now has better function labeling than transplantation coverage. Converting the strongest in-vitro function protocols into a small transplantation benchmark is likely higher-signal than inventing a new chemistry path immediately.

experimentSuggestions.title: Full-text protocol resolution for sparse islet thaw/loading workflows
experimentSuggestions.hypothesis: A small number of islet papers still look interesting, but their step structure is too thin to compare fairly against the rest of the corpus.
experimentSuggestions.rationale: The benchmarked islet slice is now minimum-depth ready, and the remaining weak points are concentrated in a few papers where only thawing or one procedural phase is explicit. Full-text resolution there is likely higher signal than another broad extraction pass.

experimentSuggestions.title: Scale-up benchmark for banked or bulk islet handling
experimentSuggestions.hypothesis: Scale-up losses in islet banking may come from handling and thaw workflow variance rather than core cryomix choice alone.
experimentSuggestions.rationale: The islet corpus includes bulk/banking/transport titles, but those papers are scattered across sparse workflow descriptions. A scale-up benchmark focused on loading, storage, thaw, and handling variance would test whether operational workflow dominates the observed recovery losses.
